objectives.description: Add check_deploy_headless_invocation_regression() scanning agent-system/ for the bash-prefixed defect form
Anchor pattern on bash-prefixed form only, with a do-not-widen comment
Guard the check on EXT_DIR (source store) presence
Choose fail() severity lane with documented rationale
Wire the check into the project-wide checks call sequence
Verify the guard fires on a deliberately reintroduced occurrence, then revert
Verify the guard is clean on the fixed tree
Verify no false positives against the four named reference-class files

approaches_tried.approach: First draft of the guard's explanatory comment spelled the defect string literally (bash scripts/deploy-headless.sh, unescaped)
approaches_tried.reason: The comment itself became a self-inflicted false positive: the guard's own grep matched its own explanatory prose. Reworded every prose occurrence to the escaped-dot form (deploy-headless\.sh) matching the grep pattern's own literal characters, which does not self-match; confirmed via grep -c on the file returning 0

notes: Guard verified end-to-end: (1) clean on the fixed tree -- 0 findings; (2) fires with a useful FAIL message and non-zero exit when a transient test line is appended to deploy-root-guard.sh, then correctly reverts to zero diff; (3) silent on all four named reference-class files (shell-strict-mode.md, ci-deploy-tree-bootstrap.md, batch-orchestration-guardrails.md, verify-deploy.sh). check-extension-docs.sh's overall exit remains 1 due to pre-existing, expected 'deployed script content drift' and 'Rule R line_count mismatch' FAILs caused by the source-store edits not yet being deployed -- both are resolved automatically by Phase 5's deploy step (the line-count FAIL message says so explicitly) and are outside this regression check's own 0-findings verdict.
